newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire down on digital worries.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire down on digital worries.

text.p: Shares in Yorkshire-Tyne Tees Television Holdings Plc slipped sharply on Monday as investors adjusted their portfolios over worries about competition from digital television, traders said.
The stock was down 70p at 11.125 pounds by 1310 GMT with volume at 752,230 shares.
"There have been a couple of crosses down at the 11.10 stg level, so everybody's having to adjust their prices downwards," one trader said.
The fall follows the formation of two digital terrestrial television consortia on Friday which have raised fears about ITV company Yorkshire's future, traders said.
One of them unites satellite broadcaster BSkyB and leading ITV companies Granada Group Plc and Carlton Communications Plc.
Granada has a 27 percent stake in northern neighbour Yorkshire and has said that it may make a full bid "at the right price".
